about: What to type, per vertical. Each entry is one prompt and the use case it runs. Banking text is the catalog's own chip text (data/usecases.json trigger.text, verbatim; a test pins it). Healthcare and retail wording is lab-written for the same use cases (lab-invented, a test proves each one runs its use case). Prompts whose use case routes Hand off (data/handoff.json) show under "Opens its own app": the chat answers them with the hand-off card, and Preview here runs them in the mock engine. Stub verticals have no demo pack yet, so no prompts.
